candidates.change_summary: Change blockAssertion from false to true so returned AssertionPolicy has blockAssertion = true.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true so returned AssertionPolicy has arbitrateViaEscalationManager = true.
Change discardOracle from false to true so returned AssertionPolicy has discardOracle = true.
Change validateDisputers from false to true so returned AssertionPolicy has validateDisputers = true.

Swap two fields: set blockAssertion = false and arbitrateViaEscalationManager = false to both true (altering two fields) — but to keep single-statement change, replace the entire return to invert all booleans to true.
Change return from always true to always false by returning false instead of true.
Negate the original condition by returning the opposite of the original true constant (i.e., !true -> false) to change the returned value.
Return true only when disputeCaller is the zero address; otherwise return false, altering observable behavior depending on input.
Return true only when the assertionId equals bytes32(0); otherwise return false, changing behavior based on assertionId.
Return value depends on both arguments: allow dispute only if disputeCaller equals msg.sender; otherwise disallow.
Replace empty view implementation with returning the constant int256 1 to change returned price.
Replace empty view implementation with returning the constant int256 0 (different from original) to change returned price.
Replace empty view implementation with returning the negated hash of identifier as int256 to produce differing, input-dependent return values.

Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from requestPrice so it can be called by any address, changing whether the PriceRequestAdded event (and thus observable state via event logs) is emitted after calls.
Add a require that always reverts, preventing requestPrice from emitting the event and altering observed state after the call.
Emit a different event payload by swapping identifier and time in the emitted event, changing observable logs produced by requestPrice.

Invert the access check in onlyOptimisticAsserter so that only callers not equal to optimisticAsserter can call functions using the modifier, altering whether requestPrice can be executed and thus its observable event emission.
